scientific_question: Does eliminating native foreground-cosmology profiling freedom cause the CamSpec-versus-HiLLiPoP Q037 exact-common-support geometry discrepancy to fall below the preregistered Q039 materiality threshold?

intervention.name: NATIVE_FOREGROUND_PROFILE_FREEDOM_OFF
intervention.scope: sampled native TT foreground nuisance profiling freedom only
intervention.reference_selection: For each implementation separately, select the lowest-objective authoritative Q032 refinement endpoint among its own nine labels. Never compare absolute objectives across CamSpec and HiLLiPoP.
intervention.application: Freeze the complete implementation-native sampled TT foreground nuisance vector from the selected within-implementation reference endpoint and apply that same vector to all nine labels of that implementation, then re-optimize the remaining parameters from each label's own authoritative Q032 refinement endpoint.

geometry_gate.leave_one_label_out: All 9 leave-one-label-out analyses must independently satisfy all three <=0.10 conditions.

prohibited_changes: change HiLLiPoP foreground templates or model form
alter Q032 exact TT common support
alter covariance or Q032 restricted precision
use Q038 coordinate ranking to modify the intervention
subtract absolute CamSpec and HiLLiPoP objectives

success_condition.meaning: Native foreground nuisance profiling freedom is sufficient under this intervention. This does not establish physical foreground contamination or a Planck systematic.

failure_condition.meaning: Native foreground nuisance profiling freedom is insufficient under this intervention. This does not establish that foregrounds have no role in the broader structural likelihood difference.
